# Astryx — Asset Credits

Astryx's world — stars, planets, glow, effects, HUD — is spawned from code, and all
**sound effects** are generated by the pure-Python `tools/gen_*.py` scripts. The
in-flight **background music** is AI-generated; the **lobby music** is a no-copyright
track by Infraction (see *Music* below).

## Music

**Lobby music** (`assets/bgm_lobby.ogg`) — plays in the docked hangar/platform lobby:

- *"The Barbarian King (Epic Cinematic Action)"* by **Infraction**
- Music by **InAudio** — https://inaudio.org/track/the-barbarian-king-cinematic/
- Promoted by **Infraction — No Copyright Music** —
  https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkRrhwhJ2Ia_ZlkTQ4XFWJA

The **3D ship & prop models** are free assets, sourced mainly from:

**Planet maps** (`assets/planets/*`) — painted balls and close-up relief.

- **Solar System Scope** solar textures (CC-BY 4.0), NASA/USGS-based:
  day maps, Earth clouds, night lights, Earth normal, Earth specular (water mask),
  Sun photosphere, Saturn ring radial strip.
  https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/
- **NASA / GEBCO** Blue Marble Next Generation elevation (`earth_height.jpg`),
  public domain (NASA Earth Observatory / GEBCO). Used as the Earth height field
  for close-up hills. Not Google Maps; Google 3D tiles are not licensed for this.
- **NASA / USGS moon mosaics** (public domain), resized to 2k equirectangular:
  Io (Galileo/Voyager), Europa (Voyager/Galileo SSI), Titan (Cassini ISS 2006),
  Enceladus (Cassini color map), Ganymede (USGS Voyager/Galileo photomosaic),
  Callisto (Voyager JPL mosaic), Phobos (Viking / Stooke PDS),
  Mimas/Tethys/Dione/Rhea/Iapetus (Cassini ISS color maps),
  Miranda/Ariel/Umbriel/Titania/Oberon (Voyager 2 / JPL / USGS),
  Triton (Voyager 2 PIA18668), Pluto (New Horizons MVIC PIA19956),
  Charon (New Horizons PIA19866). NASA images-assets + Wikimedia Commons.

Swap slot in each recipe for later USGS / NASA / ESA mosaics.

**Engine exhaust** (`assets/fx/exhaust_noise.png`) — **generated in-repo**, no third-party
asset. `tools/gen_exhaust_noise.py` bakes a seamlessly tiling 256x256 RGBA noise sheet
(periodic Perlin FBM in R/G/B plus a ridged filament channel in A) with numpy + the
stdlib `zlib`/`struct`, in the same spirit as the pure-Python `tools/gen_*.py` audio
generators. `shaders/cruiser_torch.gdshader` and `shaders/exhaust_haze.gdshader` sample
it for plume turbulence and heat shimmer. Regenerate with
`python3 tools/gen_exhaust_noise.py`; the result is deterministic (seeded).

**Black hole** — Sagittarius A\* at the galactic core is **procedurally generated** in-shader
(`scripts/galaxy_model.gd`, the `BH_EHT_SHADER`), styled after its real Event Horizon Telescope
image (dark shadow + fuzzy orange photon ring + Doppler-bright side). No model asset.
